name: Fastmail
description: Fastmail lets agents search and read email, check calendars, and look up contacts in the signed-in Fastmail account. Each user signs in through the browser and chooses which access to give, sending included.

prompts.text: Summarize the unread email in my inbox from today.
What is on my calendar for tomorrow?
Draft a reply to the latest email from my landlord.

apps.name: Fastmail
apps.description: Mail, calendar, and contacts access, over Fastmail's MCP server with browser sign-in.
